data: You create a haze of light snow that washes over creatures in a {shape}, centered on you. Any stat changes, status effects, shields or other outside forces affecting creatures in range are removed. This includes things like Leech Seed, Focus Energy, Substitute, Iron Defense, Disable, etc.
Brings down the energy of any Pokémon that have already used a move this turn.
Lowers the crowd meter by the number of Pokemon that raised the crowd meter this turn.
